subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <memory> header. Smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr including all array forms), factories (make_unique, make_shared, allocate_shared, *_for_overwrite variants), uninitialized memory algorithms, allocator+allocator_traits, and small utilities (align, to_address, assume_aligned).
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <memory> header. Smart pointers, factories, uninitialized memory algorithms, allocator + allocator_traits, and small utilities — shipped across Phases 1-6c (2026-04 .. 2026-05-02). Carry-forward gaps: aligned-new, atomic shared_ptr ops, hash specialisations, MSVC atomic refcount path.

symbols.name: addressof
symbols.notes: Used by every smart pointer and uninitialized algorithm. Bypasses overloaded operator&. Without the builtin, falls back to a reinterpret-via-char-cast helper that is constexpr-friendly only on certain compilers; default detection enables on the four major compilers.

symbols.name: pointer_traits
symbols.notes: Trait surface needed by allocator_traits. Detects member typedefs (element_type, difference_type, rebind) with sensible defaults when absent.

symbols.name: construct_at
symbols.notes: Placement-new wrapper. constexpr at C++20+ in std; restd back-ports unconditionally on C++14+.

symbols.name: destroy_at
symbols.notes: Calls p->~T(). Array destructor handling for T[N] from C++20.

symbols.name: destroy
symbols.notes: Range form of destroy_at.

symbols.name: default_delete
symbols.notes: Stateless deleter for unique_ptr. Two specialisations: T (delete) and T[] (delete[]).

symbols.name: allocator_arg_t / allocator_arg
symbols.notes: Tag type and constexpr instance for allocator-extended ctors of allocator-aware types.

symbols.name: uses_allocator
symbols.notes: Trait that signals allocator-awareness via member uses_allocator typedef on a target type.

symbols.name: bad_weak_ptr
symbols.notes: Thrown by shared_ptr ctor from expired weak_ptr.

symbols.name: allocator
symbols.notes: Default allocator. Most surface deprecated in C++17 (capacity, address, construct, destroy) and removed in C++20; restd honours the C++17 deprecation and the C++20 surface change. Ships allocator<void> specialisation.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path planned; current implementation uses C++11 deduction tools (rebind_alloc helper).

symbols.name: allocator_traits
symbols.notes: ~10 SFINAE detection points (allocate, deallocate, construct, destroy, max_size, propagate_on_*, is_always_equal, select_on_container_copy_construction, rebind_alloc).

symbols.name: unique_ptr
symbols.notes: Both <T,D> and <T[],D> specs. Pointer-type detection via void_t. Converting moves with full SFINAE. Comparison ops use raw < (not less<common_type_t>) — minor deviation from the std contract.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path requires substantial redesign (no rvalue refs); planned but deferred.

symbols.name: unique_ptr (no EBO)
symbols.notes: restd stores deleter as a member, not via EBO. Pays one word of size when D is empty; trades simplicity for slight overhead. Documented deviation from std::unique_ptr (which uses EBO via tuple<T*, D>).

symbols.name: make_unique<T>(args)
symbols.notes: Non-array form.

symbols.name: make_unique<T[]>(n)
symbols.notes: Unbounded-array form, value-init.

symbols.name: make_unique_for_overwrite
symbols.notes: Default-init variants (single + array). Back-ported unconditionally.

symbols.name: shared_ptr
symbols.notes: Atomic refcount via __atomic_* builtins (gcc/clang/intel only — MSVC interlocked path TBD). Public-but-underscored _sp_internal_from_cb factory. Comparison ops use raw < (matches unique_ptr).

symbols.name: shared_ptr<T[]>
symbols.notes: Unbounded-array partial spec. operator[] replaces operator*/->. Conversion from shared_ptr<U[]> uses qualification-only convertibility on (Y(*)[] -> T(*)[]).

symbols.name: shared_ptr<T[N]>
symbols.notes: Bounded-array spec. Decay conversion to shared_ptr<T[]> provided. Cross-element-type qualification-only conversions NOT YET implemented (rare; mechanical to add).

symbols.name: weak_ptr
symbols.notes: Paired with shared_ptr; observes without owning. lock() returns a strong shared_ptr, or empty if expired.

symbols.name: weak_ptr<T[]> / weak_ptr<T[N]>
symbols.notes: Array partial specs of weak_ptr.

symbols.name: enable_shared_from_this
symbols.notes: CRTP base. Inline-friend ADL trick: the template friend sp_esft_link is found via ADL on the cb pointer; a catch-all in restd:: (NOT internal::) ensures unqualified calls always resolve. Subtle to get right; see notes in source.

symbols.name: make_shared (single)
symbols.notes: Single allocation: cb + object. Forwards args to T ctor.

symbols.name: make_shared<T[]>(n) / (n,u)
symbols.notes: Unbounded array forms. Single-allocation byte-arithmetic layout: [cb header][pad][T[0]..T[n-1]]. Strong exception safety with reverse-order rollback. Over-aligned types (alignas > __STDCPP_DEFAULT_NEW_ALIGNMENT__) NOT YET supported — would need ::operator new with align_val_t (C++17+).

symbols.name: make_shared<T[N]>() / (u)
symbols.notes: Bounded-array forms. Same single-allocation layout via internal::array_extent helper.

symbols.name: make_shared_for_overwrite
symbols.notes: Default-init variant (single + unbounded + bounded array forms). Tag-dispatched ctor on sp_cb_inplace via internal::sp_for_overwrite_t.

symbols.name: allocate_shared (single)
symbols.notes: Allocator-aware variant of make_shared.

symbols.name: allocate_shared array forms
symbols.notes: Four array overloads (T[]+n, T[]+n+u, T[N], T[N]+u). Allocator rebound to unsigned char for the byte block; cb destroy() takes a copy of the allocator before destructing self, then deallocates via the rebound copy.

symbols.name: allocate_shared_for_overwrite
symbols.notes: Default-init allocator-aware factory (single + array forms).

symbols.name: static_pointer_cast
symbols.notes: Const-ref + rvalue overloads (rvalue-cast added in C++20 std; restd back-ports unconditionally).

symbols.name: dynamic_pointer_cast
symbols.notes: Per [util.smartptr.shared.cast] the rvalue-on-failure path leaves the source UNCHANGED (does not move-from on a failed cast).

symbols.name: const_pointer_cast
symbols.notes: Same shape as static_pointer_cast.

symbols.name: reinterpret_pointer_cast
symbols.notes: Same shape as static_pointer_cast.

symbols.name: owner_less
symbols.notes: Three specs: shared_ptr<T>, weak_ptr<T>, void (heterogeneous, is_transparent).

symbols.name: get_deleter
symbols.notes: Type-erased deleter retrieval via typeid (or restd alternate when typeinfo absent).

symbols.name: swap (smart pointers)
symbols.notes: Non-member swap for shared_ptr, weak_ptr, unique_ptr (T) and (T[]).

symbols.name: uninitialized_copy
symbols.notes: Strong exception safety: rolls back constructed elements on throw. Now uses restd::iterator_traits (Phase 5 stub retired).

symbols.name: uninitialized_copy_n
symbols.notes: Returns pair<input_iter, dest_iter>.

symbols.name: uninitialized_fill_n
symbols.notes: C++11 added a return value (past-the-end iterator); restd matches the C++11 signature on every tier.

symbols.name: uninitialized_default_construct(_n)
symbols.notes: Default-init (no parens after T): leaves trivials indeterminate.

symbols.name: uninitialized_value_construct(_n)
symbols.notes: Value-init (parens after T): zero-fills trivials. Container resize uses this.

symbols.name: uninitialized_move(_n)
symbols.notes: Move-construct from src; rollback is destination-only (any moved-from src elements remain moved-from).

symbols.name: align
symbols.notes: Power-of-two alignment via bitmask. Returns nullptr on insufficient space, leaving the input ptr/space pair untouched.

symbols.name: to_address
symbols.notes: Two-overload tag-dispatch: pointer_traits::to_address path (C++20+) preferred, operator->() recursion as fallback. function_pointer overload static_asserts against use.

symbols.name: assume_aligned
symbols.notes: Compiler hint only; informational. Degrades to identity on unknown compilers.

symbols.name: aligned_new for over-aligned types
symbols.notes: make_shared<T[]>(n) and the other array factories use plain ::operator new(bytes) — alignas-T greater than __STDCPP_DEFAULT_NEW_ALIGNMENT__ will not be honoured.
symbols.failure_reason: Needs ::operator new with align_val_t (C++17+) plus a manual over-allocation/pointer-adjust fallback for C++11/14. Focused follow-up phase.

symbols.name: atomic shared_ptr ops
symbols.notes: atomic_load(shared_ptr*), atomic_store, atomic_compare_exchange_*. Free-function form deprecated in C++20 in favour of std::atomic<shared_ptr<T>> (C++20).

symbols.name: std::atomic<shared_ptr<T>>
symbols.notes: C++20 specialisation that subsumes the deprecated free-function forms.

symbols.name: hash<shared_ptr> / hash<unique_ptr>
symbols.notes: Specialisations of std::hash for the smart pointers.
symbols.failure_reason: Awaits restd::<functional> (which provides the hash primary template).

symbols.name: MSVC atomic refcount
symbols.notes: Implementation detail (not a std symbol). shared_ptr atomic refcount uses __atomic_* (gcc/clang/intel). MSVC needs interlocked-intrinsic path. Currently MSVC builds will fail on the include.
symbols.failure_reason: Mechanical; needs InterlockedIncrement/Decrement wrappers in internal/sp_atomics.hpp.
